target_customer: Landlords, property managers and lenders who pay for verified rent payment history
problem: Landlords and lenders had no consistent source of rent payment history, since the largest database covered about 3 percent of rent data.
business_model: Usage-based API and web app sold as a Consumer Reporting Agency
product_category: Rent verification data, proptech and fintech API

founders.name: Sam Stein
previous_startups: A food tech startup (outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: Eight years in finance and private company investing; began after finding that none of his landlords had reported his rent.

founders.name: Abe Wheeler
founders.background_notes: Built AI adtech systems at Amazon; later founded Alignbase.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating rent data from landlords and payment sources and operating as a regulated CRA involved data engineering and compliance.

defensibility.rationale: CRA status and a growing rent dataset were hard to replicate quickly, though data coverage was still small.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Bureaus and rent reporting firms existed, but Snappt, an applicant trust vendor, bought Trigo in August 2025 after launching Verification of Rent powered by Trigo in June 2025.

market_need_then: The company says the largest rent database covered only 3 percent of rent data and landlords lacked verification; this is the company's own claim.

branding.domain_note: Uses trigodata.com, the name plus a data suffix, not the exact .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and commercial; headline Close More Smarter, with Verified, real-time rent history directly from the source

brand_strength.rationale: Little press on the brand itself; it lived on as a Powered by Trigo label inside Snappt's product.

outcome_analysis: Trigo built a rent history CRA from founders with finance and Amazon data backgrounds, stayed very small with little disclosed funding, and partnered with Snappt before Snappt acquired it in August 2025 at an undisclosed price. The deal fit Snappt's applicant trust platform, so this reads as a strategic tuck in rather than a scaled independent business.
notes: Funding unverified: one aggregator shows a 125K seed in June 2023 (Y Combinator, Four Acres Capital), others 500K total with a pre-seed in April 2023; aggregators only, so no round recorded. The 50M growth financing in headlines is Snappt's Hercules Capital facility, not Trigo's. Deal date varies from 31 July to 5 August 2025. CB Insights places Trigo in Texas; others say New York. Founders and acquirers are from the YC page and press release. Rent reporting competitors (Esusu, Boom, Experian RentBureau) were found only in 2025 and 2026 sources, so the dated list is empty.
